description: Estimates how much revenue a health clinic loses each month to unanswered phone calls, WhatsApp conversations that wait for a reply, and no-shows, from figures the clinic provides (a single value or a low–high range for each). A leak without its figures comes back as pending with the figures it needs; nothing is filled with averages or benchmarks. Returns monthly and yearly amounts per leak with the arithmetic, a check against the clinic's free appointment slots, and categories of fixes. Counts and percentages only: never send patient names or records.

afterHoursMissedPercent.description: Uout: Optional: of the unanswered calls, the share made outside opening hours (% of unanswered calls). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range. 0–100: 30 means 30%.

appointmentsPerMonth.description: A: Appointments booked (appointments per month). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range.

appointmentsPerWeek.description: A: Appointments booked (appointments per week). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range.

callDaysPerMonth.description: D: Days a month the calls in `C` come in (days per month). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the clinic's currency, such as EUR, GBP or USD: money in the result then carries its symbol.

feePerVisit.description: F: Average fee per visit (the clinic's currency). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range.

freeSlotsPerMonth.description: K: Free appointment slots: appointments the clinic could still book in a month with its current team and hours (appointments per month). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range.

inboundCallsPerDay.description: C: Inbound calls (calls per day). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range.

inboundCallsPerMonth.description: C×D: Inbound calls (calls per month). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range.

newPatientCallsPercent.description: N: Calls that come from new patients (% of inbound calls). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range. 0–100: 30 means 30%.

newPatientValue.description: V: Revenue from one new patient (the clinic's currency). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range.

newPatientsLostPercent.description: L: New patients not reached who never call back or book (% of new patients not reached). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range. 0–100: 30 means 30%.

noShowPercent.description: R: No-shows: the patient does not come and gives no notice (% of booked appointments). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range. 0–100: 30 means 30%.

refilledNoShowPercent.description: S: Of the no-show slots, the share filled again by another patient (% of no-shows). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range. 0–100: 30 means 30%.

repeatAttemptsPercent.description: X: If `Mu` is not available: of the unanswered calls, the share that are repeat attempts by a caller already counted (% of unanswered calls). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range. 0–100: 30 means 30%.

unansweredCallsPercent.description: U: Calls not answered (missed, abandoned or sent to voicemail) (% of inbound calls). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range. 0–100: 30 means 30%.

uniqueMissedCallersPerMonth.description: Mu: Best, if the report gives it: unique numbers among the unanswered calls, each caller counted once however many times they called (numbers per month). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range.

visitsPerNewPatient.description: T: Visits per new patient, on average (visits). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range.

whatsappConversationsPerDay.description: W: WhatsApp conversations started by patients (count people, not individual messages) (conversations per day). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range.

whatsappConversationsPerMonth.description: W×Dw: WhatsApp conversations started by patients (count people, not individual messages) (conversations per month). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range.

whatsappDaysPerMonth.description: Dw: Days a month messages come in (messages can arrive on closed days too: ask) (days per month). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range.

whatsappNewPatientPercent.description: Nw: Conversations from new patients (% of conversations). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range. 0–100: 30 means 30%.

whatsappNewPatientsLostPercent.description: Lw: Of the new patients who waited, the share who never booked (% of those who waited). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range. 0–100: 30 means 30%.

whatsappWaitingPercent.description: O: Conversations that wait for a reply: sent outside opening hours, or left unanswered (% of conversations). A number, or {"low", "high"} for a range. 0–100: 30 means 30%.

name: estimate_front_desk_loss

cappedPerMonth.description: What the clinic could recover from calls and WhatsApp within its free slots.

leaks.description: The largest calculated leak first, pending leaks last.

countPerMonth.description: New patients (or no-shows) lost per month, low and high case.

formula.description: The calculation written with the clinic's figures.

missing.description: Input names of the figures this leak still needs.

perMonth.description: Revenue lost per month, low and high case.

status.description: calculated_gross: unanswered calls counted, not callers (no repeat adjustment yet).

questions.description: One question per figure still needed, with its unit and where the clinic finds it.

total.description: The calculated leaks added up; null when none is calculated.
